name: CelesTrak SATCAT Ingest Flow
description: Per-provider ingest flow (loop C.8a), SATCAT snapshot: a module cron TIMER tick enters at celestrak-request:satcat which emits BOTH source fetches (legacy fixed-width satcat.txt and satcat.csv — runner dual-source parity); two hostcap/http-request nodes fetch, two celestrak-parser:parse_satcat nodes normalize into CAT record streams (batch = sha256 of each payload, reconcile mode 'current' since only the newest snapshot batch is meaningful), and two hostcap/storage-ingest nodes persist through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source cap op. Results land on the egress sink. After each store, celestrak-request:publish_request joins that ingest result with the parser meta and (only when node CONFIG carries celestrak_publish_url) emits the loopback dataset-publication POST that a second hostcap/http-request node drives per lane; the publication responses also land on the egress sink. All decisions live in-wasm.

externalInterfaces.description: Outbound HTTP through the host http.request hostcall. Go server host: 4 MiB response cap, 30 s default timeout. SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost: fetch-based, origin allowlists enforced by host policy.
Provenance/batch-capable record ingest through the host storage.ingest_with_source hostcall (sdn-server modulert/caps/storage.go).
